copy.tagline: 优化 ClickHouse 查询与数据工程实践
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 ClickHouse 做高性能分析并需要优化查询。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize ClickHouse queries and data engineering practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ClickHouse for high-performance analytics and need query optimization.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你设计 ClickHouse 表结构、编写优化查询、创建物化视图，并给出数据插入和 ETL 的最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你询问 ClickHouse 数据库设计、查询优化、数据分析或数据工程相关问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 ClickHouse 表来存储市场交易数据。
say.note: Claude 会给出 MergeTree 表定义示例。

say.text: 如何优化这个 ClickHouse 查询？
say.note: Claude 会分析并提供索引、聚合等优化建议。

say.text: 用 ClickHouse 做用户留存分析。
say.note: Claude 会生成留存分析的 SQL 查询。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design ClickHouse table schemas, write optimized queries, create materialized views, and provide best practices for data insertion and ETL pipelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about ClickHouse database design, query optimization, data analysis, or data engineering topics.

say_en.text: Help me design a ClickHouse table for market trade data.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a MergeTree table definition example.

say_en.text: How can I optimize this ClickHouse query?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest indexing, aggregation, etc.

say_en.text: Do user retention analysis with ClickHouse.
say_en.note: Claude will generate SQL for retention analysis.
